source: Daily Communications Job Feed automation — first-run expanded open-role feed

jobs.title: Senior Advisor, Corporate Communications
jobs.summary: Strategic communications advice, media relations, corporate publications, web and social content, and stakeholder communications.
jobs.fit: Strong match for your senior-leadership counsel at UJA, media-relations experience at AthletesCAN, and cross-channel communications strategy.
jobs.gap: You'll need to learn the regulator's energy-sector context; French is listed as an asset, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Commercial Communications Manager — 12-Month Contract
jobs.summary: Strategic communications for commercial leaders, internal and external messaging, town halls, sales conference content, and communications measurement.
jobs.fit: Your leadership advisory work, editorial storytelling, and ability to connect organizational priorities with audience-focused messaging align closely.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for extensive beverage-industry knowledge and experience with a commercial sales organization.

jobs.title: Multi-Media Content Creator
jobs.summary: Part-time newsroom role creating and publishing news content across digital and broadcast channels, including WordPress publishing and digital audience optimization.
jobs.fit: Your editorial judgment, digital storytelling, WordPress experience, and sports-media background are relevant.
jobs.gap: The role is hands-on newsroom work with video, photography, broadcast systems, and variable shifts rather than communications leadership.

jobs.title: Email Marketing & Campaigns Coordinator
jobs.summary: Supports the email marketing program, content calendar, campaign coordination, approvals, and communication between stakeholders and the email agency.
jobs.fit: Your email-platform experience and campaign/content planning experience translate directly to the channel and coordination responsibilities.
jobs.gap: This is a coordinator-level execution role and sits below your target seniority.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Fan Access
jobs.summary: Supports fan-engagement marketing campaigns, member communications, rewards, email and social channels, and campaign reporting.
jobs.fit: Your sport-sector background and experience with digital campaigns, audience engagement, and communications calendars are relevant.
jobs.gap: The posting targets 1–3 years of experience and is a part-time, 10-month contract at coordinator level.

jobs.title: Email Marketing Cloud Specialist (Contract)
jobs.summary: Contract email-marketing role within MLSE's digital marketing team.
jobs.fit: Your experience with Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Stripo, email campaigns, and performance reporting provides a relevant foundation.
jobs.gap: The role appears to emphasize hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud and lifecycle-marketing execution; direct Salesforce experience isn't established in your profile.

jobs.title: Global Marketing Communications Manager
jobs.salary: $109,000–$159,000 CAD/year (base plus target short-term incentive compensation)
jobs.summary: Leads strategic B2B marketing campaigns, sales enablement, technical content, events, brand consistency, and campaign performance measurement.
jobs.fit: Your strategic storytelling, campaign leadership, content development, and cross-functional communications experience are transferable.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 14+ years of B2B technology marketing and deep data-centre, networking, and computing knowledge.
